•	the design of highly integrated end-to-end solutions with customized software for IT Security oriented product lines, like the EXYS9000 product family.
These solutions optimize signal processing performance under demanding operating conditions typically found in emerging market environments. In the cloud computing market, Eclexys offers high performance, low power memory interface solutions that enable memory intensive server applications. Eclexys latest developments for DPI into mobile and security are enabling the customers to develop a new wave of products by by implementing increasingly sophisticated approaches in converged communications.

entityDescription: Officially registered in 2014, Iotic Labs formed as a skunk works within the established and successful M2M company, Arkessa, addressing the emerging needs of connectivity across data types irrespective of their source and type. Iotic Labs is a small company with under 15 employees, yet it has a large reach and is working across multiple sectors. These include automotive, rail, construction, as well as Smart Cities and health and social services. This is because Iotic Labs’ technology and capability is sufficiently generic to suit any situation in which greater intelligence can be reached through making data from varied sources available in order to create a richer picture against which better decisions can be made, and in which good, accurate decisions must be made by humans, machines or both. Iotic Space works with data silos, creating the ability to bring in disparate sources of data from sensors or other extraneous sources to give new understanding and perspective. Owing to the way in which Iotic Space brokers the sharing of data and traces its use, it is being deployed in situations in which a high level of trust and security is required – with no data source, let alone data, being visible unless it has chosen so – and in which data owners can see and track who is using their data and for what reason. This makes Iotic Space the solution of choice when an audit trail of data use is needed, which is helping to evaluate the true worth of data and to create new business models for data sharing.

entityName: FCiências.ID - Associação para a Investigação e Desenvolvimento de Ciências
entityDescription:
FCiências.ID – Associação para a Investigação e Desenvolvimento de Ciências (FC.ID) is a Non-Profit Private Association endowed with legal personality. It was created in 2017 as a common initiative of the Faculdade de Ciências da Universidade de Lisboa (CIENCIAS UL) - a Higher Education institution - and 6 private companies. FC.ID’s goal is to support, potentiate and develop the Research, Development and Innovation (R&D) activities of its seven associates, while simultaneously enhancing CIENCIAS UL strategic partnerships with market and service companies, thus creating a more challenging environment for research and innovation.
FC.ID is the legal representative of 12 National Science and Technology System (SNCT) research centres, in multiple fields of science including Environmental Sciences, Mathematics, Statistics and Operational Research, Physics, Space and Astrophysics, Chemistry and Biochemistry, Geology, Geophysics, Biology, Computer Science and Informatics and Philosophy and History of Sciences, among others. 
FC.ID performs its own research activities and is responsible for the administrative, financial and scientific management of the R&D projects of its associated research centres. 
Following specific agreements, each FC.ID associate may act as a third party, supplying resources to FC.ID in its R&D projects. A third party agreement with CIENCIAS UL is in force. As an Affiliated Entity, CIENCIAS UL carries out its own share of work, notwithstanding the full responsibility of FC.ID for the contracted scientific and technical work.

entityName: ATHENA - Environmental and Networking Technologies and Applications Unit (ΕΝΤΑ)
entityDescription:
The Unit of Environmental and Networking Technologies and Applications (ENTA), at ATHENA-RIC in Xanthiis dedicated to promoting fundamental and applied research in all aspects of the contemporary environmental and networking problems, such as climate change and space networking. More specifically, the applications promoted by ENTA intent to assist society, individual citizens and the local production sectors to achieve a better quality of life, increase productivity, product competitiveness and wealth.
Characteristic example is the primary agricultural production that in order to guarantee the quality of its produce or to certify its “biological” origin, requires the use of remote sensing, networking technologies, atmospheric pollution monitoring the monitoring of climate change and of meteorological and micrometeorological parameters. Furthermore, ENTA can assist the local government in cases of local accidents or natural disasters, even in remote and not easily accessible areas. Regions of Greece like East Macedonia and Thrace that has limited road network and difficult to access areas, suffers from natural disasters that are difficult to respond to. In general, Greece with its numerous islands and mountainous mainland is in need of specialized equipment and technologies to improve its competitiveness, promote its products and counteract natural disasters. To this end, ENTA intends to combine technologies and knowhow from a number of scientific fields so as to assist in the progress that the region and the country requires.

entityDescription:
ShipNow Technologies was founded in 2015, by its sole owner, Leonel Simão, and is currently based in the city of Coimbra, Portugal (the exact address being Rua Pedro Nunes, 3030-199 Coimbra, Portugal). ShipNow aims at structuring the resources and processes required to address the express carrier and freight market from an innovative perspective: to ensure more accessible, quicker and cheaper express and freight transportation for potential users. 
Currently, ShipNow Technologies is developing the YOUSHIP platform, which will be the company's key asset. This platform will be responsible for creating value, linking users who need to send orders or who have made purchases/sales and carriers who manage shipments.
The platform's functioning mode was initially planned to be intuitive and simple for all of the platform's users. Then, and to overcome any possible competition, we looked into the state of the art of applications available on the market and which operate in the same context. Having performed this analysis, the YOUSHIP business model was planned - using the Canvas methodology - having identified possible challenges, obstacles and critical success factors to succeed in the market.

entityDescription:
CAL-TEK is a Limited Liability Company established as Software Company and located in South Italy where a team of skilled designers and smart developers support business creation, software development and carry out research projects in cooperation with other companies, universities and research institutions. CAL-TEK provides consulting services to major stakeholders in different domains (e.g. NATO STO CMRE) from industry to logistics, defence and cultural heritage.
CAL-TEK has acquired experience in Software Development, Modelling & Simulation, virtual and augmented reality, 3D immersive visualization, Mobile Phone Application Development, Responsive Web Design, Client Server Applications and IT platforms. The company gained an extensive knowledge and background about programming languages, Java, Html 5, Php, Css, Java Script, C++, Database Development (My Sql, J Query), Operative Systems Management(Android, IOS, Windows).
CAL-TEK covers also expertise in Cloud Computing Services (Windows Azure, Google App Engine, Amazon Web Services, Ubuntu Elastic Cloud), Software Testing and Quality Assurance. 
Historically CAL-TEK was born as a Company active in the field of Modelling & Simulation, where it is official supplier of Simulation services of NATO STO CMRE (Centre for Maritime Research and Experimentations) and has gained many experiences in the field of Virtual and Augmented Reality. Moreover, CAL-TEK is involved in many projects at different levels:
-	as partner in research projects both at national and international level.
-	offering technical consulting services covering a wide range of areas in the field of Modelling and Simulation, Virtual Reality, 3D Visualization and Augmented Reality.
-	supporting the organization of different international conferences in the Modelling & Simulation area such as the International Multidisciplinary Modelling & Simulation Multiconference (I3M), including the European Modelling and Simulation Symposium (EMSS), The International conference on Modelling and Applied Simulation (MAS), The International Conference on Harbour, Maritime & Multimodal Logistics Modelling and Simulation (HMS), The International Defence and Homeland Security Simulation Workshop (DHSS), The International Workshop on Innovative Simulation for HealthCare (IWISH), the International Workshop on Simulation for Energy, Sustainable Development & Environment (SESDE), Food Operations and Processing Simulation Workshop (FoodOPS).
CAL-TEK has an extensive knowledge about simulation paradigms, methodologies and applications and is able to handle innovative technologies (i.e. mobile technologies) and paradigms such as simulation based serious games, interoperable simulation, web-based simulation, real time simulation, distributed and parallel simulation, and intelligent agents. In this domain, CAL-TEK avails of advanced development tools (i.e. graphic simulation engines for real-time virtual 3D simulation) but is also able to develop simulation tools from scratch without using any commercial tool. Other core capabilities include the ability of developing complex, immersive 3D virtual scenarios and Augmented Reality applications(able to support virtual and constructive simulation) integrating Human-in-the-loop and Hardware-in-the-loop solutions.
